settings.signOutBody: Practices on this phone stay. You'll need to sign in to play again.
settings.deleteBody: Your email, fighter and name will be deleted, and this can't be undone. Games and ratings stay, no longer linked to you, so other players' games stay whole. Your name becomes free for other players.
settings.deletePasswordBody: To delete the account, enter the password of {{email}}.
settings.deletedPartly: Your account was deleted. We couldn't delete your sign-in details: signing in with them starts a new registration.
